notes.title: Dev Blog #1 - Announcing Flock Off!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re the team behind Flock Off!, and we couldn’t be more excited to officially reveal our game to the world.[/p][p]So, what [i]is[/i] Flock Off!?[/p][p]It’s a chaotic first-person action adventure game for 1-4 players, where everything is a weapon, even your friends! After a cloning experiment gone wrong, the Scottish Highlands are infested with zombie sheep, and you have to use whatever you can to survive the horde.[/p][h3]Why Are We Making This Game?[/h3][p]We love co-op games. And we [i]especially[/i] love the ones that don’t take themselves too seriously. We wanted to make something that was silly, tense, and most importantly fun. The most memorable moments for us when playing games is when things go horribly wrong and you end up in tears of laughter. That’s the kind of chaos we want to bring to the world![/p][h3]Where We’re At[/h3][p]We’re deep in development and have been working on Flock Off! for a while now. We can’t wait to share more behind the scenes and WIPs in the near future.[/p][p]We’re aiming for a Q4 2025 launch, and we guarantee things will only get weirder from here.[/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/65ca3139ffbf2750e4bb8a77/6c21781b-8aeb-4a67-a3b7-7e12d57a16b8/FlockOff-20250617-CelerySwing-600x240.gif"][/img][/p][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][p]We’re planning a closed playtest later this Summer, and we’d love to get some of you involved. Keep an eye out for more information about that soon.[/p][p]If any of that sounds like your thing, you can:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021550/Flock_Off/"]Wishlist us on Steam[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Follow us on socials for some dev chaos and cursed sheep content[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for being here for Day One. We’re just getting started.[/p][p]— The Flock Off! team[/p]
